entries.title: A user can connect, replace, and disconnect a Figma token on the integrations page
criteria: Open the integrations page at /integrations.
Enter a valid Figma personal access token in the Figma card and click Connect.
The card displays the connected Figma handle and connection status.
Click Replace key and enter a new token to update the connection.
Click Disconnect and confirm the connection is removed.

evidence.what_was_seen: All 9 integration and settings card tests passed for connect, replace key, invalid key preservation, and disconnect

entries.title: A user can import Figma frames from a link onto a canvas
criteria: Open an existing canvas and open the Import modal.
Select Figma as the import source and paste a Figma frame or file link.
Review the discovered frames list and choose which frames to import.
Click Import and observe the frames land on the canvas as editable HTML.
Inspect the new canvas frame to verify layout, text, colors, and image fills render correctly.

evidence.what_ran: bun run test tests/figmaIntegration.test.ts tests/figmaSettingsCard.test.tsx tests/figmaImportSection.test.tsx
evidence.what_was_seen: All 14 tests passed verifying frame discovery across pages, selective import, layout conversion, text and asset image resolution, and import modal UI

entries.title: An MCP agent can import Figma frames onto a canvas
criteria: Call the import_figma tool with a canvas ID and Figma URL.
The tool returns success with the imported frame details.
Verify the imported frame exists on the canvas with correct dimensions and HTML content.

evidence.what_was_seen: All 14 tests passed verifying MCP import_figma tool call, canvas frame creation with correct dimensions and HTML, and agent tool parity

entries.title: The interface provides clear recovery messages for connection and link errors
criteria: Opening Figma import while disconnected directs the user to connect their token.
Submitting an invalid token displays a helpful error and keeps the card interactive.
Submitting a malformed Figma link displays an error explaining the expected format.
Figma API rate limits return a human-readable message without resetting existing state.

evidence.what_ran: bun run test tests/figmaIntegration.test.ts tests/figmaSettingsCard.test.tsx tests/figmaImportSection.test.tsx
evidence.what_was_seen: All 24 tests passed verifying clear recovery messages for invalid tokens, malformed links, rate limits, and interactive state preservation

entries.title: Figma tokens remain private and remote images pass validation
criteria: Verify GET /api/integrations never returns the Figma personal access token.
Replacing an invalid token keeps the previous valid token intact until verified.
Imported remote image fills pass through asset creation validation before saving.

entries.title: The integration passes all automated test suites and type checks
criteria: Run bun test tests/figmaIntegration.test.ts and verify all tests pass.
Run bun test tests/agentToolParity.test.ts and verify all parity checks pass.
Run bun run typecheck with zero errors.
Run bun run lint with zero warnings and zero errors.
